country: Multiple (Canada, Netherlands, South Africa, Taiwan, USA)
sample_unit: published challenging hyponatremia cases (each submitted twice, Dec 2023 and Sep 2024)

links.outcome: Whether ChatGPT-3.5 recognized the crucial cause of hyponatremia and gave adequate therapy in four difficult cases
links.effect: In 2023 ChatGPT missed the crucial cause in all four cases, as did the 46 clinicians. In 2024 it diagnosed and managed one case adequately. It recognized Addison's disease in case 1, which 81% of clinicians missed.
links.quote: Neither ChatGPT, in 2023, nor the previously published assessment by 46 clinicians, whose assessment was described in the original publication, recognized the most crucial cause of hyponatremia with major therapeutic consequences in all four cases.

screen.reason: The study empirically tests the diagnostic and treatment recommendation accuracy of ChatGPT-3.5 using four challenging clinical hyponatremia case vignettes compared to clinician responses.
